risk_note: Payment path, RV2, the user's authorization boundary (D10-1030 ②, HANDOFF:1206, D10-1155 ①): before the first real business type is registered, a payment must be limited to the caller's own business object. BizTypeEntry gains a required ownedBy({appId, userId, bizRef}), so no type can be registered without it; test_item answers true (no real object, non-production only), and the production registry is still empty. createPayOrder asks it after the switch and platform checks, before the price and before any write. False answers 30901 reason=biz_not_sellable (D10-1156 ①: no contract change, not told apart from a missing object, so it reveals neither existence nor owner); nothing is priced, written, queued or sent to a channel. A hook that throws is not caught: 50001 and no order. No money moves; no migration; no frozen test changes. BR-PAY-01 has no text for this yet: the orchestrator writes it back in the next spec batch (D10-1156 ②). When a real type is connected, ownership changes against order creation and idempotent replay have to be checked for that type (money r1 note).
